The '''''Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics''''' is an [[open access]] [[peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] of [[economics]], published by [[Springer Science+Business Media|SpringerOpen]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=SpringerOpen |website=Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics |url=https://sjes.springeropen.com/ |access-date=10 July 2024}}</ref> on behalf of the [[Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics]], and financially supported by the {{ill|Swiss Academy of Humanities and Social Sciences|de|Schweizerische Akademie der Geistes- und Sozialwissenschaften}} and the [[Swiss National Bank]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics |url=https://www.sgvs.ch/journal/ |access-date=10 July 2024 |website=Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=About |url=https://sjes.springeropen.com/about |access-date=10 July 2024 |website=Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics}}</ref> The current [[editor-in-chief]] is [[Marius Brülhart]].<ref name="Editorial Board">{{Cite web |title=Editorial Board |url=https://sjes.springeropen.com/about/editorial-board |access-date=10 July 2024 |website=Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics}}</ref>

==History==
The journal was established in 1864 as the ''Zeitschrift für Schweizerische Statistik'' (in [[German language|German]]) and ''Journal de Statistique suisse'' (in [[French language|French]]).<ref name=":0" /> Its first editor was [[Johannes Stössel]], the secretary of the [[Federal Statistics Bureau (Switzerland)|Federal Statistical Bureau ]], who served as an editor from 1864 to 1869.<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last=Baechtold |first=Hermann |date=1914 |title=Die Schweizerische statistische Gesellschaft 1864—1914 |url=https://www.sgvs.ch/papers/sjesBackIssues/1914_PDF/1914-I-25.pdf |journal=Zeitschrift für Schweizerische Statistik |language=de |volume=I |issue=25 |pages=261 |via=SSES Archives}}</ref>

In 1916, the journal was titled ''Zeitschrift für schweizerische Statistik und Volkswirtschaft'' (in German) and ''Journal de statistique et Revue économique suisse'' (in French), and from 1945 onwards, it was named ''Schweizerische Zeitschrift für Volkswirtschaft und Statistik'' (in German), ''Revue suisse d'Économie politique et de Statistique'' (in French), and ''Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics'' (in English).<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Scheurer |first=Frédéric |date=1964 |title=Un quart de siècle d'histoire de la Société suisse de Statistique et d'Économie politique 1939-1964 |url=https://www.sgvs.ch/papers/1964-IV-4.pdf |journal=Revue suisse d'Économie politique et de Statistique |language=fr |volume=IV |issue=4 |pages=616 |via=SSES Archives}}</ref>

Although the journal is now published entirely in English, issues prior to the first edition of 2007 also accepted articles written in German, French and [[Italian language|Italian]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Brown |first1=Martin |last2=Grossmann |first2=Volker |last3=Lalive |first3=Rafael |last4=Tille |first4=Cédric |date=2018 |title=Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics |journal=Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics |volume=154 |issue=1 |pages=1–2 |doi=10.1186/s41937-018-0020-4 |doi-access=free |pmid=30443494 |pmc=6214255 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Information about organization |url=https://dodis.ch/R18753?lang=en |access-date=11 July 2024 |website=[[Diplomatic Documents of Switzerland]]}}</ref>
